WITH po AS (SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS oct_total, COUNT(*) AS po_count FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-10-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-11-01'), tgt AS (SELECT CAST((annual_sales_target ->> 'amount') AS DECIMAL) AS target_amount, annual_sales_target_currency FROM contracts WHERE status = 'active' LIMIT 1) SELECT po.oct_total, po.po_count, tgt.target_amount, tgt.annual_sales_target_currency, po.oct_total / tgt.target_amount AS completion_ratio, po.oct_total / tgt.target_amount * 100 AS completion_percent FROM po, tgt

SELECT TO_CHAR(submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount, SUM(item_qty) AS total_boxes, COUNT(DISTINCT po_id) AS po_count FROM (SELECT po.id AS po_id, po.submitted_at, po.total_amount, COALESCE(i.qty, 0) AS item_qty FROM purchase_orders AS po LEFT JOIN (SELECT po_id, SUM(quantity) AS qty FROM purchase_order_items GROUP BY po_id) AS i ON i.po_id = po.id WHERE po.submitted_at >= '2026-05-01' AND po.submitted_at < '2026-11-01') AS t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100
SELECT title, annual_sales_target, annual_sales_target_currency, term_start_date, term_end_date FROM contracts WHERE status = 'active' LIMIT 100

SELECT rf.sku, p.product_name_en, p.product_name_native, rf.numeric_value AS stock_on_hand, rf.period_start, rf.period_end, rf.status AS fact_status, sr.status AS report_status FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = rf.product_id WHERE rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.period_start >= '2026-10-01' AND rf.period_start <= '2026-10-31' ORDER BY rf.sku LIMIT 100

**核心要点：**
*   **业绩表现**：9月已确认销售额为 2,231.20，较8月的 2,251.46 小幅回落约 0.9%。因无生效合同，无法计算销售目标完成度。
*   **库存风险**：三款主力产品期末库存均低于当月销量，预计剩余天数不足 10 天（Bouteille d'eau evian 6L 仅约 8.3 天），存在断货隐患。
*   **采购状况**：9月采购金额 11,990.17（484 箱）。但系统中有 8 张采购单逾期预警，其中 7 张仍为 `awaiting_payment`（合计 15,437.90），需尽快处理以保障后续供货。
executed_sql: WITH confirmed_reports AS (SELECT id, reporting_period FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed'), periods AS (SELECT DISTINCT reporting_period FROM confirmed_reports) SELECT p.reporting_period, SUM(f.numeric_value) AS revenue, COUNT(f.id) AS fact_count FROM periods AS p LEFT JOIN confirmed_reports AS r ON r.reporting_period = p.reporting_period LEFT JOIN report_facts AS f ON f.report_id = r.id AND f.metric_key = 'revenue' AND f.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY p.reporting_period ORDER BY p.reporting_period DESC LIMIT 6

WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(period_end) AS pe FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed') SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en, SUM(f.numeric_value) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS f JOIN sales_reports AS r ON r.id = f.report_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = f.product_id CROSS JOIN latest WHERE r.status = 'confirmed' AND f.status = 'confirmed' AND f.metric_key = 'units_sold' AND f.period_end = latest.pe GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name_en ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 100

WITH latest AS (SELECT id, reporting_period, period_start, period_end FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY period_end DESC NULLS LAST, reporting_period DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en, p.product_name_native, rf.numeric_value AS stock_on_hand, rf.unit, l.reporting_period, l.period_start, l.period_end FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN latest AS l ON rf.report_id = l.id LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = rf.product_id WHERE rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY p.sku

answer:
2026年9月采购月报已生成，请在右侧“报表”标签页查看。

**核心摘要：**
*   **销售表现**：9月已确认销售额 2,231.20（9笔），8月为 2,251.46（9笔），环比下降约 0.90%，整体基本持平。因当前生效合同为 0 份，无法计算合同口径的目标完成度。
*   **采购情况**：9月提交采购单 4 笔，合计 484 箱、金额 35,970.51；较 8 月（300 箱、17,484.69）箱数增长约 61%、金额增长约 106%，为近六个月峰值。主要增量来自 Bouteille d'eau evian 6L（BEV-3068320125367）从 20 箱增至 132 箱。
*   **库存风险**：三款在售产品预计可售天数均在 8 天左右（均低于 15 天），触发补货告警。其中 Bouteille d'eau evian 6L 库存仅 19 件，断货风险最高。
*   **待处理事项**：有 11 张未完成采购单（合计 27,428.07），其中 7 张状态为 `awaiting_payment` 且预计到达日已过（最早为 2026-08-20），需优先跟进付款与入库。
executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS contract_count FROM contracts LIMIT 100

SELECT poi.product_name, poi.sku, SUM(poi.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(poi.line_total) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN purchase_order_items AS poi ON poi.po_id = po.id WHERE po.submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND po.submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY poi.product_name, poi.sku ORDER BY poi.product_name, poi.sku LIMIT 100

WITH periods AS (SELECT DISTINCT period_start, period_end FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND metric_key = 'revenue' AND NOT period_start IS NULL ORDER BY period_start DESC LIMIT 2), rev AS (SELECT rf.period_start, rf.period_end, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN periods AS p ON rf.period_start = p.period_start AND rf.period_end = p.period_end WHERE rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'revenue' GROUP BY rf.period_start, rf.period_end), tgt AS (SELECT c.id, c.annual_sales_target, c.annual_sales_target_currency FROM contracts AS c WHERE c.status = 'active') SELECT r.period_start, r.period_end, r.revenue, r.fact_count, t.annual_sales_target, t.annual_sales_target_currency FROM rev AS r LEFT JOIN tgt AS t ON TRUE ORDER BY r.period_start DESC

WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(period_start) AS ps FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND metric_key = 'units_sold' AND NOT period_start IS NULL) SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN latest AS l ON rf.period_start = l.ps LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = rf.product_id WHERE rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'units_sold' GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name_en ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 100

WITH monthly AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', po.submitted_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(po.total_amount) AS purchase_amount, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT po.id) AS order_count FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN purchase_order_items AS i ON i.po_id = po.id WHERE NOT po.submitted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 6) SELECT month, purchase_amount, total_cases, order_count FROM monthly ORDER BY month

SELECT poi.product_name, poi.sku, SUM(poi.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(poi.line_total) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN purchase_order_items AS poi ON poi.po_id = po.id WHERE po.submitted_at >= '2026-08-01' AND po.submitted_at < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY poi.product_name, poi.sku ORDER BY poi.product_name, poi.sku LIMIT 100

WITH latest AS (SELECT id, reporting_period, period_start, period_end FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY period_end DESC NULLS LAST, confirmed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en, p.product_name_native, rf.numeric_value AS stock_on_hand, rf.unit, l.reporting_period, l.period_start, l.period_end FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN latest AS l ON rf.report_id = l.id LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = rf.product_id WHERE rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY p.sku
